nodes.description: Public token name string, set once in the constructor to 'MARVEL INU'.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor to 'MINU'.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 total supply, minted to the deployer in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (burn accounting).
Returns the balance of a given tokenOwner.
Returns the remaining allowance a spender may use on behalf of tokenOwner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
Checked addition helper: c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction helper: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
Checked multiplication helper with division-based overflow check (unused by MARVEL).
Checked division helper: require(b > 0); c = a / b (unused by MARVEL).
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender and recipient across the contract.
Unchecked plain subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) computed inside transfer().
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) computed inside transfer().
safeSub(balances[from], tokens) computed inside transferFrom().
safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) computed inside transferFrom().
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) computed inside transferFrom().
Address parameter of balanceOf used to index the balances mapping.
Owner address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of approve, keys the allowed mapping.
Amount parameter of approve written into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer used in safeSub and safeAdd.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in both safeSub calls and safeAdd.

edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
Constructor writes the initial value of _totalSupply.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner, so the caller controls the written slot.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], controlled by the caller.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burned-supply subtraction.
transfer reads and updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and updates the allowed mapping.
transfer delegates its debit computation to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates its credit computation to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub twice (balance and allowance).
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient credit.
totalSupply performs an unsigned subtraction that can underflow if balances[address(0)] exceeds _totalSupply.
transfer computes safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
Result of the sender debit is written back into balances.
transfer computes safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
Result of the recipient credit is written back into balances.
transferFrom computes safeSub(balances[from], tokens).
Debited source balance is written back into balances.
transferFrom computes safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens).
Reduced allowance is written back into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom computes safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
Credited recipient balance is written back into balances.
Unchecked subtraction consumes the _totalSupply state variable.
Unchecked subtraction consumes balances[address(0)].
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the inner allowance mapping.
spender parameter keys the allowanc slot written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
tokens parameter flows into the allowed state variable.
to parameter is the recipient credited by transfer.
to parameter indexes the balances mapping being credited.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the sender debit.
tokens parameter is the addend of the recipient credit.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the source balance.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance.
